SWED 100.description: Students with native or near-native proficiency in a Scandinavian language (e.g. Danish, Norwegian, Swedish) cannot participate in the elementary Swedish courses (SWED 100 and SWED 110), but are welcome to join the intermediate courses (SWED 200 and SWED 210).
